# Member rewards

Members earn one reward point for every NGN 1,000 spent on completed, non-refunded merchandise. Points are calculated after any approved discount and exclude shipping charges, tax, gift cards, and cancelled order lines. Points expire 12 months after they are earned. Reward points cannot be exchanged for cash or transferred to another member account.

## Welcome promotion

The WELCOME10 promotion gives a new member ten percent off eligible standard merchandise on a first completed order. It does not apply to final-sale clearance, wholesale orders, gift cards, or delivery charges. The code may be used with free standard delivery only when the order independently meets the shipping policy's NGN 75,000 threshold after eligible discounts are applied.

## Seasonal promotion

The HOMEWEEKEND promotion gives NGN 5,000 off selected home-appliance SKUs when the discounted merchandise subtotal is at least NGN 100,000. It cannot be combined with WELCOME10, staff pricing, or wholesale pricing. The promotion does not make express delivery free. Product pages may show an item in the Home category without confirming that the item is selected for this promotion.

## Communication rules

Marketing copy may simplify an offer, but the approved promotion terms control eligibility. Support should state the named promotion, qualifying subtotal, and exclusions rather than promising an unverified discount. A customer who receives an error at checkout may have an ineligible item, an expired promotion, or another code already applied.

## Eligibility checks

Before support confirms a benefit, it should identify the exact code, the order type, the merchandise subtotal, and any exclusions shown here. Membership does not automatically make every item eligible for WELCOME10, and a Home category label does not automatically make an appliance eligible for HOMEWEEKEND. An eligible promotion can lower the merchandise subtotal enough that a separate shipping threshold no longer applies. The shipping policy, rather than this document, controls whether delivery is free.

## Limits of this document

This document does not authorize a retrospective discount, a cash payment for unused points, a wholesale price, or an exception to a final-sale item rule. It also does not decide whether an order is already completed, dispatched, refunded, or returned. If the terms do not clearly cover a customer request, support should state that the benefit cannot be confirmed from the approved promotion terms instead of inferring a favorable outcome. This preserves a clear distinction between a published offer and an operational decision.

For audit purposes, each approved promotion decision should retain the code and the order condition that made it eligible. That record does not replace the published terms as evidence.
